description: Dr. Mike Eisenhauer is running as an Independent to represent Montana’s 2nd District with integrity and action, not partisanship. From his nearly 25 years of military service to providing cardiac care in rural Montana communities, Mike knows selfless service. Now, he’s tackling the issues that matter most: economic relief, border security, mental health, and protecting […]
